correctness.rationale: For the Cartesian two-row path ladder P_n×K2 the complex consists of subsets of *perfect* matchings. Cut parity enforces paired upper/lower horizontals, converting each perfect matching to a tiling of n columns by rungs and horizontal domino pairs. Folding the tile-overlap independence complex twice gives K_n≈ΣK_{n-2}; odd n contractible, n=2m≥4 has sphere S^(m-1). Row interchange is contiguous to identity. End reversal permutes tile-orbits; the signed reduced Lefschetz sum is governed by Z_j=−Z_(j−2), giving the integral orientation sign (-1)^(m choose2) for reversal and its product with the row swap. The group quotient preserves the rational spherical line exactly when m mod4=0,1. Independently enumerated perfect-matching tilings, all faces and signed actions for n=2..10 and checked exact parity signs; these samples support the general folding/Lefschetz proof but are not its replacement.
